description: Search the CMF (Chile's financial regulator) register of sanction resolutions, about 1,500 resolutions from 2002 to today: each row has the resolution number, date, subject (e.g. 'APLICA SANCIÓN A ITAÚ CORREDORES DE BOLSA LIMITADA') and a link to the resolution document. Filter by free-text query (Spanish; matches the subject, accent- and case-insensitive, all words must match) and/or year. Resolutions that name individuals are served with the person's name as the register publishes it (Bruce's case ruling of 2026-10-25, scoped to this tool): every row carries its source record (resolution number, date, CMF document link); no address is ever served for an individual and a natural person's RUT is stripped from the subject; anyone named can ask for removal at support@pipeworx.io and a removed name is replaced in the subject and its document link dropped (counted in withheld_by_removal_request). Each row has a subject_kind (person | organisation | mixed | unclassified) assigned only from explicit cues in the subject (honorific = person; corporate-form word = organisation); a bare personal name with neither cue is 'unclassified', not guessed, and subject_kind_basis says why. When nothing matches, returns found:false with the exact scope searched (a sanction announced in a press release but absent from the register is not covered).

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 25, max 200). Newest first.

query.description: Optional Spanish words to match in the resolution subject, e.g. "Itaú" or "Cooperativa Oriente". All words must match.
